rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I am Vito Holleshorn, special
envoy for Superbia. A pleasure
to make your acquaintance.

rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0002
rows.name:
As a token of our acquaintance, allow
me to tell you something useful.

rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Did you know that every weapon used by
a Driver has an element?

rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0004
rows.name:
For example, weapons with the fire
element are effective against
monsters of the water element...

rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Also Blades have a fixed element
that represents their power.

rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Kagutsuchi-sama and Wadatsumi-sama,
Superbia's imperial banners, are fire
and water respectively.

rows.label: tlk70000074_01_msg0007
rows.name:
Matching your weapon and Blade
elements to counter the monster's
element is key to clinching victory.
